chapter_title: Concerning the Nourishment of the Person, for there are Powers in it [ ... / ... ]
chapter_note: Heavily damaged chapter with extensive lacunae, but the readable portions are almost entirely oldest-layer body-cosmos correspondence teaching. The chapter describes the human body as a microcosmic purification machine: 250,000 seals and 250,000 rulers, cleansing/purification processes, expulsion of dark rulers through transmigration. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system — body structures correspond to cosmic powers, digestive purification corresponds to light-dark separation. The only editorial element is a fragmentary dialogue frame opening. No editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation material is present. The computational pipeline returns all zeros, likely because the heavy lacunae prevent vocabulary density calculations from registering, but the text is clearly substrate in character.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] exists [ ... ] daily to the body of the person [ ... ] there are two hundred and fifty thousand seals in it [ ... ] there are another two hundred and fifty thousand rulers [ ... ] they are cleansed and purified and enter [ ... ] ⟨p.265⟩ by the voice, by the word, and by the [ ... ... ] quiet with the silence at the time when his heart [ ... ... ] of God the Father.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed '[Once again] speaks' — fragmentary dialogue frame attribution formula at paragraph opening.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opens with fragmentary dialogue frame formula '[Once again] speaks [...]' followed by substrate body-cosmos mapping. The teaching describes precise numerical correspondences (250,000 seals, 250,000 rulers) in the human body — classic substrate enumeration of cosmic powers inhabiting the microcosm. The purification process ('cleansed and purified') and the sensory-spiritual channels ('by the voice, by the word') are cosmic-process vocabulary. 'God the Father' likely renders the Father of Greatness — a cosmological entity within the system. Heavy lacunae obscure much of the original structure.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, the twelve [ ... ... ] rulers that belong to the Darkness shall be swept out outside in wandering and in transmigration [ ... ... ] some of them [ ... through] this transmigration, and others among them shall be brought back.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure substrate cosmological process description. The twelve rulers of Darkness are cosmic entities; their expulsion through 'wandering and transmigration' describes a systematic cosmic mechanism — the body expelling dark powers as dregs after purification. Both sides of the mapping remain within the cosmic system: dark rulers → transmigration process. The differentiation ('some... others') is characteristic of substrate teaching that discriminates degrees within a process. Capitalized 'Darkness' as it functions as a personified cosmic domain.
